message: Disk usage on /var/lib/data exceeded 95% threshold, write operations may fail.
ai_analysis: 1. Likely root cause: log or temp-file retention has not been rotated/cleaned and has filled the data volume close to capacity. 2. Severity impact: critical — imminent write failures will corrupt or drop data and can crash the process entirely once the disk is full. 3. Precise fix required: immediately purge rotated logs and stale temp files to free space, then attach a larger volume or enforce a retention/rotation policy so this cannot recur.

message: Rate limit threshold reached for API key user-admin-247.
ai_analysis: 1. Likely root cause: a single API key (user-admin-247) is issuing a burst of requests that exceeds its configured per-minute quota, possibly from a retry loop or a misconfigured polling job. 2. Precise fix required: contact the key's owner to confirm expected traffic patterns, add backoff/retry logic client-side, and consider a temporary quota bump if the load is legitimate.
